outfit.note: 이보람의 홀터넥·튤 드레스, 남규리의 연보라 리본·벌룬 드레스, 김연지의 층층이 레이스 드레스와 당시 헤어를 참고했어요. 작은 장식은 도트로 단순화했으며, 한 번 뽑으면 세 멤버의 의상과 헤어를 함께 얻어요.

prompt: Create a transparent pixel-art modular wardrobe atlas for the SEEYA game. 1536x1024, exactly3 columns512 wide. Reference1 is mandatory exact chunky pixel style and detached-head/body layout. References2-4 are actual September2007 Marry Me stage wedding dresses, for costume detail only; do not copy photo realism, people, scenery or typography. Fixed left-to-right LEFT Lee Boram, CENTER Nam Gyuri, RIGHT Kim Yeonji, matching left/center/right in reference2 thumbnail. TOP y0-590: standalone heads with hair only facing straightforward, simple square eyes, tiny red mouth, thick darkpixel outlines; chins at y365; all hair within y575. BOTTOM y640-1010: HEADLESS full bodies from tiny visible neck to shoes, centered x290,770,1245, width<=330px, arms neutrally at sides. Transparent separation between head and body. LEFT BORAM: long black loose curls, half-up with side-swept fringe, large silver oval dangling earrings; white sparkling HALTER V-neck fitted bodice (not strapless), waist sash, flared knee-length tulle skirt with delicate frilled lace hem, white ankle-strap heels. CENTER GYURI: long dark-brown curly two low ponytails and wispy straight bangs with tiny braids/hairpins along crown, silver drop earrings; white strapless bodice with prominent pastel LAVENDER ribbon bow at waist, rounded balloon/bubble mini skirt with large gathered petal folds, white ankle-strap shoes. RIGHT YEONJI: long straight chestnut hair, full side-swept bangs across forehead, slender silver drop earrings; white strapless fitted bodice, narrow sparkly belt, knee-length skirt formed of FOUR distinct horizontal lace ruffle tiers, white platform ankle-strap heels. No invented bridal veil, no tiara/crown, no bouquet or microphone. All skirts remain short/knee length and feet visible. Preserve game style rather than realistic bridal fashion drawing. No shadows, background, text, labels or scenery. Genuine transparent alpha; crisp square pixels, no antialiased painterly faces.
